title: INT8 weight-only: integration harness, calibration sweep, and regression gate
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: We need a robust, numerically-aware integration test harness for INT8 weight-only quantization profiles (GPTQ/AWQ variants) that can validate accuracy regressions across kernels, sequence-length distributions, and hardware variants. Current transient tests are fragmented: unit quantization checks exist, nightly golden diffs run sporadically, and release gating lacks a reproducible stochastic sweep. This ticket implements a reproducible 'calibration sweep' driver, end-to-end regression gate, and telemetry hooks so we can detect subtle numerical drift introduced by kernel swaps, compilation flags, or microbatching changes.

Goals:
- Build an integration harness that runs profile synthesis + in-situ calibration across representative prompts and per-model answer metrics.
- Implement a deterministic sweep driver with seed control, controlled perturbations, and statistical aggregation (mean/median/KS tests) rather than single-sample deltas.
- Add a regression gate that can be used in CI and canary pipelines: if delta metrics exceed thresholds, fail the build and attach example failing prompts and variance traces.
- Capture telemetry for token-level divergences, per-layer quant stat snapshots, and kernel/runtime metadata (GPU type, kernel variant, quant backend).

Scope:
- Support GPTQ and AWQ pipelines for weight-only INT8 profiles.
- Validate on small-to-medium open models (Llama2-7B, MPT-7B, and a customer-supplied 8B variant).
- Run across CPU fallback, NVIDIA A100, and Ampere-like hardware where possible in our infra mocks.
- Produce human-friendly failure artifacts: golden-answer diffs, answer clusters, and reproducible scripting to replay failures.
acceptance_criteria: Integration harness runs end-to-end for GPTQ and AWQ weight-only flows and completes in CI under 90 minutes for the smoke suite
Sweep driver produces deterministic runs when provided seed and logs seed value in artifacts
Regression gate enforces numeric thresholds (mean token-level logprob delta < 0.015, KS p-value > 0.01) and fails CI when exceeded
Artifacts (answer deltas, per-layer quant stats, kernel metadata) are uploaded to the artifact store and linked in the CI failure report
Telemetry events are emitted to observability pipeline with dimensions: model, profile-id, kernel-variant, hardware, sequence-length-bucket
Playbook documented for debugging reproducible failures and a go/no-go checklist for rollout to Dedicated and Private clusters
tasks: Design sweep driver: seed management, perturbation matrix (scale, clip, noise), and aggregation metrics
Implement harness adapter for GPTQ flow (profile ingestion, weight-only transform, inference runner)
Implement harness adapter for AWQ flow (ensure compatibility with per-layer multiplier tables and packing format)
Instrument runtime to export per-layer quant stats (zero-point distributions, scale histograms, outlier counts)
Add kernel metadata tagging to telemetry (kernel name, cuBLAS/cuDNN fallback flag, custom kernel hash)
Create CI job template (smoke + nightly extended) with artifact upload and failure summary generation
Write regression gate logic and integrate into PR pipeline with configurable thresholds
Author runbook: reproduce-failure.sh, debug checklist, and rollback guidance for model-serving releases
Collect representative prompt corpus and golden references for each model in the smoke suite
